criteria.requirement: Add wtforms.partial.validate_fields(form,paths,extra_validators=None) and PartialResult(valid,validated,errors). paths are explicit segment tuples, supporting FormField names and strict integer FieldList indices; preflight unknown/duplicate/overlapping ancestor-descendant masks before any validation. Validate only selected targets through actual field.validate with owning form, explicit extras then original class inline validator, copying sequences without mutating caller lists. Return deep-copied path-associated errors, preserve every unselected error/state and support empty mask without claiming whole-form validity. Do not run/deem passed cross-field Form.validate overrides; document callers must perform full validation for global rules and that selected container fields invoke their normal whole-container rules.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
